exercises.title: 必修一 U1 听力·对话 Choosing a Club
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Adam: Hi Sam, have you chosen a club yet?
Sam: Not yet. I'm thinking about the Ballet Club or the Debate Club.
Adam: Do you like dancing or speaking more?
Sam: Actually, I enjoy discussing different topics.
Adam: Then the Debate Club is suitable for you.
Sam: Good idea! What about you?
Adam: I joined the Volunteer Club. Every week we help homeless people.
Sam: That sounds great. I'll sign up for the Debate Club today.
exercises.translation_cn: Adam 问 Sam 选社团了吗;Sam 在芭蕾社和辩论社之间犹豫,说自己喜欢讨论不同话题;Adam 建议他选辩论社,并说自己加入了志愿者社、每周帮助无家可归的人;Sam 决定今天就报名辩论社。

questions.answer_text: The Ballet Club and the Debate Club.

exercises.title: 必修一 U1 听力·短文 My First Day
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Today was my first day at senior high school.
In the morning I felt a little anxious because I am not very outgoing.
My first maths class was difficult, but the teacher was kind and friendly.
He told us a funny story, and everyone laughed.
In the afternoon, the boy next to me talked too much, so I couldn't concentrate.
By the evening, I felt much more confident, and I made two new friends.
exercises.translation_cn: 今天是我高中第一天。早上因为不太外向有点紧张;第一节数学课很难,但老师很和善,还讲了个有趣的故事,大家都笑了;下午旁边的男生话太多,我无法集中注意力;到傍晚我自信多了,还交了两个新朋友。

exercises.title: 必修一 U1 听力·对话 Learning Strategies
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Amy: Li Ming, how do you study English so well?
Li Ming: I take notes in class and review them every evening.
Amy: Do you also watch English videos?
Li Ming: Yes, I watch short videos and try to copy the pronunciation.
Amy: That's helpful. I like to make mind maps to organise my ideas.
Li Ming: Good idea. We can share our methods with each other.
Amy: Great! Working together makes learning more fun.
exercises.translation_cn: Amy 问李明英语为什么学得好;李明:上课记笔记、每晚复习,还看短视频模仿发音;Amy 喜欢用思维导图整理想法;两人决定互相分享方法,一起学习更有趣。

questions.stem: What does Li Ming do every evening?
How does Li Ming improve his pronunciation?
What does Amy like to make?

What does Amy think about working together?
options: It is a waste of time.

exercises.title: 必修一 U1 听力·短文 Advice About Games
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: My friend Chen Lei plays computer games too often.
He spends too much time online and cannot focus on his studies.
I am worried about him.
Our teacher says it is normal for teenagers to be attracted to games.
But she also says spending too much time online is unhealthy.
She recommends that we try new hobbies, such as sports or reading.

exercises.title: 必修一 U1 听力·对话 Planning a Camp
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Max: Cao Jing, would you like to join a summer camp?
Cao Jing: Sure! What kind of camp is it?
Max: There are two. One is an adventure camp where we learn survival skills.
Cao Jing: That sounds exciting! What about the other one?
Max: It's an international youth camp. We can practise spoken English there.
Cao Jing: I'd like to improve my English, so I prefer the youth camp.
Max: Good choice. We'll also meet students from different countries.
exercises.translation_cn: Max 问曹静要不要参加夏令营;有两个:一个是学野外生存技能的探险营,一个是能练口语的国际青年营;曹静想提高英语,更喜欢青年营;Max 说在那儿还能认识来自不同国家的学生。

exercises.title: 必修一 U1 听力·短文 Being Responsible
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: As teenagers grow up, they become responsible for more things.
At home, they help their parents and take care of themselves.
At school, they are responsible for their own studies and behaviour.
When you show that you can be responsible, adults trust you more.
For example, if you finish your homework on time, your parents will not worry.
No one becomes responsible in a single day, but we can learn from our mistakes.
exercises.translation_cn: 随着青少年长大,他们要对更多事情负责:在家帮父母、照顾自己;在校对自己的学业和行为负责;当你表现得有责任心,大人会更信任你;比如按时完成作业,父母就不担心;没人能一天就变得有责任心,但我们能从错误中学习。

questions.stem: What happens as teenagers grow up?
options: They become responsible for more things.
questions.answer_text: They become responsible for more things.
